constant function DamageModify_DeadFixerAbility takes nothing returns integer
    //一個可以增加大量生命值上限的技能，可用增加生命上限的物品技能修改
    return 'A0TZ'
endfunction

function DamageModify_Finish takes timer t returns nothing
    local unit u = GetHandleUnit(t,"u")
    if GetHandleBoolean(t,"fix") then
        call UnitRemoveAbility( u, DamageModify_DeadFixerAbility() )
    endif
    call SetUnitState(u ,UNIT_STATE_LIFE, GetHandleReal(t,"finalhp") )
    call SetHandleUnit(u,"#DamageModify:Timer",null)
    call FlushHandleLocals(t)
    call PauseTimer(t)
    call DestroyTimer(t)
    set u = null    
endfunction

function DamageModify_Expire takes nothing returns nothing
    call DamageModify_Finish(GetExpiredTimer())
endfunction

// 執行順序：傷害事件→DamageModify→真正受到傷害扣血→DamageModify_Expire→DamageModify_Finish
function DamageModify takes real dmgnew returns nothing
    local unit u = GetTriggerUnit()
    local timer t = GetHandleTimer(u,"#DamageModify:Timer")
    local real life
    local real mlife
    local real dmg
    local real delta
    if (t!=null) then
        //如果此部隊正進行傷害修改，則先完成之前的設定以免造成衝突
        //此舉是為了避免像Bash這種可能同時輸出2個傷害的情形
        //雙傷害的執行順序：傷害事件(1)→DamageModify(1)→真正受到傷害扣血(1)→傷害事件(2)→DamageModify(2)
        //        →DamageModify_Finish(1)→真正受到傷害扣血(2)→DamageModify_Expire(2)→DamageModify_Finish(2)
        call DamageModify_Finish(t)
    endif
    set dmg = GetEventDamage()
    if (dmg < 0.01) then
        //忽略負數和過小的傷害。
        //0傷害通常由buff造成，不是真正的傷害；另外，若是呼叫此函數的時機錯誤(不在傷害時件下呼叫)，此值為0
        //如有特殊需要也可把這個判斷刪掉。
        return
    endif
    set life = GetUnitState(u, UNIT_STATE_LIFE)
    set mlife = GetUnitState(u, UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE)
    set delta = dmg - dmgnew
    if (life-dmgnew < 0.0) then
        //修改後如果會死，就把生命值降到底限，讓它受到傷害死亡。
        //(0.41接近生命值最低極限，即使只是降到0.40也會使部隊死亡)
        call SetUnitState(u, UNIT_STATE_LIFE, 0.41)
        return
    endif
    if (life+delta > mlife) then
        //這種情況下無法先加血再自然扣，所以只好另外設個計時器，等扣完再調整血量。
        set t = CreateTimer()
        if (dmg >= mlife) then
            //傷害過大，足以致死，必須先調增最大生命值
            call UnitAddAbility( u, DamageModify_DeadFixerAbility() )
            set mlife = GetUnitState(u, UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE)
            call SetHandleBoolean(t,"fix",true)
        endif
        call SetUnitState(u ,UNIT_STATE_LIFE, mlife )
        call SetHandleTimer(u,"#DamageModify:Timer",t)
        call SetHandleUnit(t,"u",u)
        call SetHandleReal(t,"finalhp",life-dmgnew)
        call TimerStart(t, 0, false, function DamageModify_Expire)
        set t = null
    else
        //這種情況下可以直接加血讓它自然扣回
        call SetUnitState(u ,UNIT_STATE_LIFE, life+delta )
    endif
endfunction

//可毀物檢測
function Destruct_Judge takes nothing returns nothing
    if ( IsDestructableAliveBJ(GetEnumDestructable()) == true ) then
        call KillDestructable( GetEnumDestructable() )
    endif
endfunction

//擊退函式
function Move_Func takes nothing returns nothing
    local location P1
    local location P2
    local location P3
    local unit MoveUnit = GetHandleUnit(GetExpiredTimer(), "MoveUnit" )
    local real Angle = GetHandleReal(MoveUnit, "Angle" )
    local integer Distance = GetHandleInt(MoveUnit, "Distance")
    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()

    if ( Distance > 0 ) then
       set P1 = GetUnitLoc(MoveUnit)
       set P2 = PolarProjectionBJ(P1, 50.00, Angle)
       call SetUnitPositionLoc( MoveUnit, P2 )
       set P3 = GetUnitLoc(MoveUnit)
       if(DistanceBetweenPoints(P3,P1) < 10) then
           call SetUnitPositionLoc( MoveUnit, P1 )
           call AddSpecialEffectLocBJ( P1, "Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\ThunderClap\\ThunderClapCaster.mdl" )
           call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
           call EnumDestructablesInCircleBJ( 150, P1, function Destruct_Judge )
           call SetHandleInt( MoveUnit, "Distance", 0)
       else
           call AddSpecialEffectLocBJ( P3, "Objects\\Spawnmodels\\Undead\\ImpaleTargetDust\\ImpaleTargetDust.mdl" )
           call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
           set Distance = Distance - 1
           call SetHandleInt( MoveUnit, "Distance", Distance)
       endif
    else
       call FlushHandleLocals(t)
       call FlushHandleLocals(MoveUnit)
       call DestroyTimer(t) 
    endif

    call RemoveLocation (P1)
    call RemoveLocation (P2)
    call RemoveLocation (P3)
    set t = null
    set MoveUnit = null
endfunction

//創造計時器
function Set_Move_Value takes unit MoveUnit , integer Distance , real Angle returns nothing
    local timer t

    set t = CreateTimer()

    call SetHandleUnit(t ,"MoveUnit", MoveUnit)
    call SetHandleInt( MoveUnit, "Distance", Distance)
    call SetHandleReal( MoveUnit, "Angle", Angle)
    call TimerStart(t, 0.04, true, function Move_Func)

    set t = null
endfunction

// 一段時間後刪除目標特效

function RemoveEffectSP_Action takes nothing returns nothing
    local effect R_Effect = bj_lastCreatedEffect
    local real LifeTime = bj_enumDestructableRadius
    call PolledWait( LifeTime )
    call DestroyEffect( R_Effect )
endfunction

function RemoveEffectSP takes effect R_Effect , real Life_Time returns nothing
    local real Bj_Timer = bj_enumDestructableRadius
    set bj_lastCreatedEffect = R_Effect
    set bj_enumDestructableRadius = Life_Time
    call ExecuteFunc("RemoveEffectSP_Action")
    set bj_enumDestructableRadius = Bj_Timer
endfunction

// 一段時間清除目標單位
// 語法：call RemoveUnitSP( RemoveUnit , lifeTime , DieTime)
// 死亡時間為 負數 則為無死亡移除，0以上為有死亡移除
// 因為是由PolledWait所作，故可能有0.2秒左右延遲
//
function RemoveUnitSP_Action takes nothing returns nothing
    local unit T_Unit = bj_lastCreatedUnit
    local real Life = bj_enumDestructableRadius
    local real Die = bj_randomSubGroupChance

    call PolledWait( Life )
    if( Die < 0.00 )then
        call RemoveUnit( T_Unit )
    else
        call KillUnit( T_Unit )
        call PolledWait( Die )
        call RemoveUnit( T_Unit )
    endif
endfunction

function RemoveUnitSP takes unit R_unit , real Life_Time , real Die_Time returns nothing
    local unit Last = bj_lastCreatedUnit
    local real Bj_Timer = bj_enumDestructableRadius
    local real Bj_Rand = bj_randomSubGroupChance
    set bj_lastCreatedUnit = R_unit
    set bj_enumDestructableRadius = Life_Time
    set bj_randomSubGroupChance = Die_Time
    call ExecuteFunc("RemoveUnitSP_Action")
    set bj_lastCreatedUnit = Last
    set bj_enumDestructableRadius = Bj_Timer
    set bj_randomSubGroupChance = Bj_Rand
endfunction

// 計算兩部隊的距離
function DistanceBetweenUnit takes unit A, unit B returns real
    local real dx = GetUnitX(B) - GetUnitX(A)
    local real dy = GetUnitY(B) - GetUnitY(A)
    return SquareRoot(dx * dx + dy * dy)
endfunction

//傷害觸發連結===================================================================
//這是給予每個部隊每次受傷會run一次的連結
function DamageLink takes nothing returns nothing
    local unit DesT = GetTriggerUnit()
    local unit Dsource = GetEventDamageSource()
    local integer loopA
    local integer loopEnd2 = udg_Des_Buffcnt
    local integer loopEnd1 = udg_Des_Utypcnt

//test
    local integer buffcnt = UnitCountBuffsEx(DesT, true, true, false, false, false, false, false)

     //   call BJDebugMsg(I2S(buffcnt))

//先關掉觸發，要不然之後觸發傷害的會當同時傷害造成無限迴圈
    call DisableTrigger( GetTriggeringTrigger() )

//原先是全部執行後才判斷，這種寫法可去除原來的執行動作

//********************************
//UnitType類型觸發執行，是正確的對象才會跑
    set loopA = 0
    loop
        exitwhen loopA > loopEnd1 
        if (  GetUnitTypeId(Dsource) == udg_Des_UType[loopA] ) then        
            call TriggerExecute( udg_Des_UtypTri[loopA] )
            exitwhen true
        endif   
        set loopA = loopA + 1
    endloop
//buff類型觸發執行，如果身上有buff才會開始跑
    set loopA = 0
    if (buffcnt > 0) then
    loop
        exitwhen loopA > loopEnd2 
        if (  UnitHasBuffBJ( DesT , udg_Des_Buff[loopA]) ) then   
            if  (udg_Des_DNC[loopA]==false) then                
                call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( udg_Des_Buff[loopA], DesT )  
            endif
            call TriggerExecute( udg_Des_BuffTri[loopA] )
            exitwhen true
        endif   
        set loopA = loopA + 1
    endloop
    endif


//開啟觸發並清空暫存變數
    call EnableTrigger( GetTriggeringTrigger() )
    set DesT = null
    set Dsource = null
endfunction

function InitSetup takes unit DesUnit returns nothing
    local trigger Tri
    local triggeraction TriAct 
    
    set Tri = CreateTrigger()
    set TriAct = TriggerAddAction( Tri , function DamageLink )

    call TriggerRegisterUnitEvent( Tri , DesUnit , EVENT_UNIT_DAMAGED )

    call SetHandleTrigger(  DesUnit , "DTri" , Tri    )
    // 傷害的觸發
    call SetHandleTriggerAction(  DesUnit , "DAct" , TriAct )
    // 傷害的動作

    set Tri = null
    set TriAct = null
    set DesUnit = null
endfunction

function UnitDieUnReg takes nothing returns nothing
    local unit Un = GetDyingUnit()
    local trigger Tri
    local triggeraction TriAct

//無傷害觸發部隊判別
//    if  ( GetHandleTrigger(Un , "DTri") == null )  then
//        call TextUse("QQ",GetDyingUnit(),15,2,0,100,0)
//        return
//    endif

    if ( IsUnitInGroup(GetDyingUnit(), udg_Des_Group) == false ) then
        return
    endif


    set Un = GetDyingUnit()
    if( ( not( IsUnitType(Un,UNIT_TYPE_HERO) ) ) or ( IsUnitIllusion( Un ) ) )then
//如果觸發 符合 非英雄 或 幻影，取出紀錄的觸發資料並刪除他
        set Tri    = GetHandleTrigger( Un ,"DTri")
        set TriAct = GetHandleTriggerAction( Un ,"DAct")

        call TriggerRemoveAction( Tri , TriAct )
        call DestroyTrigger( Tri )

        call FlushHandleLocals(  Un  )
        call GroupRemoveUnitSimple( GetDyingUnit(), udg_Des_Group )
    endif

    set Un = null
    set Tri = null
    set TriAct = null
endfunction

    local trigger Tri

    // 子程式   有單位死亡就把觸發移除，避免造成記憶體問題
    set Tri = CreateTrigger()
    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ( Tri, EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DEATH )
    call TriggerAddAction( Tri, function UnitDieUnReg )

    set Tri = null
endfunction

function Sakuya_SpaceMagic_Turn takes nothing returns nothing
    local timer  ct     = GetExpiredTimer()
    local unit   caster = GetHandleUnit( ct, "caster" )
    local real   pass   = GetHandleReal( ct, "passtime" ) + 0.04
    local player cp     = GetOwningPlayer( caster )

    local unit   tk
    local real   angle
    local real   radius

    call SaveHandleReal( ct, "passtime", pass )

    if ( pass <= 0.05 ) then // 第一次執行
        set udg_I1 = 1
        loop
            call SaveHandleHandle( ct, "TurnU#"+I2S(udg_I1), CreateUnit(cp,'e00V',GetUnitX(caster),GetUnitY(caster),0.00) )
            set udg_I1 = udg_I1 + 1
            exitwhen udg_I1 > 4
        endloop
    elseif ( pass <= 0.09 ) then // 第二次執行
        set udg_I1 = 5
        loop
            call SaveHandleHandle( ct, "TurnU#"+I2S(udg_I1), CreateUnit(cp,'e00V',GetUnitX(caster),GetUnitY(caster),0.00) )
            set udg_I1 = udg_I1 + 1
            exitwhen udg_I1 > 8
        endloop
    endif

    if ( pass <= Sakuya_ApaceMagic_DurTime() ) then
        set udg_I1 = 1
        loop
            set tk     = GetHandleUnit(ct,"TurnU#"+I2S(udg_I1))
            set angle  = ModuloReal( (pass*6.28+I2R(udg_I1)*1.57) , 6.28 )
            set radius = RMinBJ(50+150*pass,200)
            call SetUnitPosition( tk, GetUnitX(caster)+radius*Cos(angle) , GetUnitY(caster)+radius*Sin(angle) )
            call SetUnitFacing( tk, ModuloReal(angle+1.80 , 6.28)*bj_RADTODEG )

            set tk = GetHandleUnit(ct,"TurnU#"+I2S(udg_I1+4))
            if ( tk != null ) then
                set angle = ModuloReal(angle+0.79 , 6.28)
                set radius = RMinBJ(40+120*pass,150)
                call SetUnitPosition( tk, GetUnitX(caster)+radius*Cos(angle) , GetUnitY(caster)+radius*Sin(angle) )
                call SetUnitFacing( tk, ModuloReal(angle+1.80 , 6.28)*bj_RADTODEG )
            endif

            set udg_I1 = udg_I1 + 1
            exitwhen udg_I1 > 4
        endloop
    else
        set udg_I1 = 1
        loop
            call KillUnit(   GetHandleUnit(ct,"TurnU#"+I2S(udg_I1)) )
            call RemoveUnit( GetHandleUnit(ct,"TurnU#"+I2S(udg_I1)) )
            set udg_I1 = udg_I1 + 1
            exitwhen udg_I1 > 8
        endloop
        call FlushHandleLocals( ct )
        call DestroyTimer( ct )
    endif

    set ct     = null
    set caster = null
    set cp     = null
    set tk     = null

            set Count1 = Count1 + 1

function JudgeFunc takes nothing returns boolean
    if ( not ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0ZI', GetTriggerUnit()) > 0 ) ) then
        return false
    endif
    if ( not ( GetRandomInt(1, 10) == 4 ) ) then
        return false
    endif
    return true
endfunction


function Trig_FlyAway_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
    local unit RiderHideUnit

    if ( JudgeFunc() ) then
        set udg_Mentor_UnitPoint = GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit())
        call CreateNUnitsAtLoc( 1, 'hfoo', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), udg_Mentor_UnitPoint, bj_UNIT_FACING )
        set RiderHideUnit = GetLastCreatedUnit()
        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', RiderHideUnit )
        call UnitAddItemByIdSwapped( 'will', RiderHideUnit )
        call ShowUnitHide( RiderHideUnit )
        call UnitUseItemTarget( RiderHideUnit, GetLastCreatedItem(), GetTriggerUnit() )
        call RemoveLocation(udg_Mentor_UnitPoint)
        call TriggerSleepAction( 1.00 )
        call KillUnit( RiderHideUnit )
        call RemoveUnit( RiderHideUnit )
    else
    endif

endfunction

function InitTrig_FlyAway takes nothing returns nothing
    set gg_trg_FlyAway = CreateTrigger(  )
    call TriggerAddAction( gg_trg_FlyAway, function Trig_FlyAway_Actions )
endfunction
